text: The yellow of the Mapleton stable
why: ¶200 says the yellow of the Mapleton stable showed to the front, and ¶191 gives Desborough (Lord Backwater's Mapleton horse) a yellow cap, so the label names something the story has already shown.

text: Four days later, the horses come up the straight and pass the post
why: ¶183 says 'Four days later' Holmes and Watson went to the Wessex Cup race, and ¶200 shows the horses coming up the straight and passing the post.
